div.div: مَؤُوفٌ , (Ks, T, S, M, Msb, K,) originally مَأْوُوفٌ, (Msb,) and ↓ مَئِيفٌ , (Ibn-Buzurj, T, K,) Affected, or smitten, with what is termed آفَة; (T, S, M, &c.;) applied to wheat, (Ks, Ibn-Buzurj, T, M,) or seed-produce, (S, K,) &c. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
